answer: SELECT count(*) AS variable_spend_buyers FROM buyers WHERE buyer_risk_profile->>'spend_pattern' = 'Variable'

WITH listings AS (
  SELECT p."ProdCat", count(*) AS active_listings
  FROM products p WHERE (p.product_availability->>'qty_avail')::numeric > 0
  GROUP BY p."ProdCat"),
tx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tp."ProdCat", t."EventCode", t."AcqLink"
  FROM transaction_products tp JOIN transactions t ON t."EventCode" = tp."EventLink"),
lang AS (
  SELECT tx."ProdCat",
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.communication_details->>'lang_pattern_type'='Consistent') AS consistent_lang_threads,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.communication_details->>'lang_pattern_type'='Suspicious') AS suspicious_lang_threads,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.communication_details->>'lang_pattern_type'='Variable') AS variable_lang_threads
  FROM tx JOIN communications c ON c."EventLink" = tx."EventCode" GROUP BY tx."ProdCat"),
sb AS (
  SELECT tx."ProdCat",
    count(DISTINCT b."AcqCode") FILTER (WHERE (b.buyer_risk_profile->>'behavior_consistency_scr')::numeric < 50
       AND split_part(b.buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio',' ',1)::numeric > 0.1) AS suspicious_buyers
  FROM tx JOIN buyers b ON b."AcqCode" = tx."AcqLink" GROUP BY tx."ProdCat")
SELECT l."ProdCat" AS product_category, l.active_listings,
  COALESCE(lang.consistent_lang_threads,0) AS consistent_lang_threads,
  COALESCE(lang.suspicious_lang_threads,0) AS suspicious_lang_threads,
  COALESCE(lang.variable_lang_threads,0) AS variable_lang_threads,
  COALESCE(sb.suspicious_buyers,0) AS suspicious_buyers
FROM listings l LEFT JOIN lang ON lang."ProdCat" = l."ProdCat" LEFT JOIN sb ON sb."ProdCat" = l."ProdCat"
ORDER BY l.active_listings DESC
note: Suspicious Buyer thresholds not given; used behavior_consistency_scr < 50 and risk_dollar_ratio > 0.1. Active listing = qty_avail > 0.

answer:
SELECT m."PlatCode", m."PlatName",
  ROUND(((0.4 * (m.platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::numeric
        + 0.3 * (m.platform_compliance->>'sec_event_count')::numeric
        + 0.3 * NULLIF(regexp_replace(m."RepScore", '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric) / 100), 4) AS mrs
FROM markets m
ORDER BY mrs DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT c."EventLink",
  ROUND((c.communication_details->>'keyword_match_count')::numeric / NULLIF((c.communication_details->>'msg_count_total')::numeric, 0), 3) AS ssd
FROM communications c
ORDER BY ssd DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT v."SellerKey",
  split_part(v.vendor_compliance_ratings->>'liq_rate', ' ', 1)::numeric AS plr,
  count(t."EventCode") FILTER (WHERE t."RouteComplex" = 'Simple') AS simple_route_txns,
  count(t."EventCode") FILTER (WHERE t."RouteComplex" = 'Medium') AS medium_route_txns,
  count(t."EventCode") FILTER (WHERE t."RouteComplex" = 'Complex') AS complex_route_txns
FROM vendors v LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."VendorLink" = v."SellerKey"
GROUP BY v."SellerKey", v.vendor_compliance_ratings
ORDER BY plr DESC NULLS LAST
note: Used stored liq_rate (USD/day) as PLR; average_price has no direct vendor column.

WITH b AS (
  SELECT b."AcqCode", split_part(b.buyer_risk_profile->>'risk_dollar_ratio', ' ', 1)::numeric AS brdr
  FROM buyers b),
bk AS (
  SELECT "AcqCode", brdr, NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY brdr) AS bucket FROM b WHERE brdr IS NOT NULL),
tx AS (
  SELECT t."AcqLink", t."CrossBorder",
    CASE WHEN cs."AnonLevel"::numeric >= 7 THEN 'High' WHEN cs."AnonLevel"::numeric >= 4 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS anon
  FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN connection_security cs ON cs."TxnPointer" = t."EventCode")
SELECT CASE bk.bucket WHEN 1 THEN 'Low BRDR' WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium BRDR' ELSE 'High BRDR' END AS brdr_bucket,
  count(DISTINCT bk."AcqCode") AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN tx."CrossBorder" = 1 THEN 1.0 WHEN tx."CrossBorder" = 0 THEN 0.0 END), 4) AS cross_border_share,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tx.anon = 'High') AS high_anonymity_sessions,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tx.anon = 'Medium') AS medium_anonymity_sessions,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tx.anon = 'Low') AS low_anonymity_sessions
FROM bk LEFT JOIN tx ON tx."AcqLink" = bk."AcqCode"
GROUP BY bk.bucket
ORDER BY bk.bucket
note: Bucket boundaries not defined anywhere; used NTILE(3) terciles of BRDR. AnonLevel is numeric 1-10 in the data; mapped >=7 High, >=4 Medium, else Low (assumption).

SELECT cs."TxnPointer",
  split_part(cs."Threat_handle_rate", ' ', 1)::numeric AS thr,
  b."AuthLevel" AS buyer_auth_level
FROM connection_security cs
LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."EventCode" = cs."TxnPointer"
LEFT JOIN buyers b ON b."AcqCode" = t."AcqLink"
ORDER BY thr DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT m."PlatCode", m."PlatName", m."OperStatus",
  count(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'escalation_tier_stat' = 'Level3') AS tier3_escalation_cases,
  count(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'Critical') AS critical_alerts,
  count(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'High') AS high_alerts,
  count(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'Medium') AS medium_alerts,
  count(a."EventTag") FILTER (WHERE a.alert_case_management->>'severity_level_stat' = 'Low') AS low_alerts
FROM markets m
LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t."PlatformKey" = m."PlatCode"
LEFT JOIN alerts a ON a."EventTag" = t."EventCode"
WHERE (m.platform_compliance->>'vuln_inst_count')::numeric < 10
  AND (m.platform_compliance->>'protection_meas_count')::numeric > 15
GROUP BY m."PlatCode", m."PlatName", m."OperStatus"

SELECT t."RouteComplex" AS route_complexity, count(*) AS txn_count
FROM transactions t
GROUP BY t."RouteComplex"
ORDER BY txn_count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN cs."AnonLevel"::numeric >= 7 THEN 'High' WHEN cs."AnonLevel"::numeric >= 4 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS anonymity_level,
  ROUND(AVG(cs."OpSecMetric"::numeric), 2) AS avg_opsec_score
FROM connection_security cs
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_opsec_score DESC
note: AnonLevel is stored as a 1-10 number, not High/Medium/Low; mapping >=7 High, >=4 Medium, else Low is an assumption.
